holdout_card.fact_statement: The Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms, and Explosives could not find evidence that the 2025 Tesla vandalism attacks were coordinated.
holdout_card.answer: Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms, and Explosives
